_doc: Single source of truth for the constellation 'wrapper chrome' — the permanent top bar every app we own renders so the hierarchy Cloud-SuperApp ▸ Cloud-Comms ▸ {Mail,Mattermost,Element} feels like ONE owned product instead of separate apps. Because we fork+own the three comms apps, their branding patch injects this bar; the hub renders it natively; Cloud-SuperApp is the root. Baked into the hub at build time and consumed by each fork's branding patch.

chain.label: Cloud-SuperApp
chain._doc: Root of the chain. Its own launcher icon stays; opened via its launch intent.

chain.label: Cloud-Comms
chain._doc: The hub. Keeps its launcher icon (the ONE icon in the one-icon model). Opened via its launch intent.

top_bar._doc: Rendering contract for the permanent bar. Each app renders a back-button (icon + label) for every `chain` entry that is NOT itself — so the hub shows [Cloud-SuperApp] and each fork shows [Cloud-SuperApp][Cloud-Comms]. Tapping opens that ancestor (launcher intent; ancestors keep their icons). The bar is ALWAYS visible (the forks' branding patch pins it above their own chrome — see forks/*/README.md). An ancestor that isn't installed shows but toasts on tap.
